scope: Ordinary guild invitation ownership at the packet handler boundary
baseline: Guildless ordinary InviteRequest raises NullReferenceException in GuildCommand.ProcessCurrent.
result: Nine focused checks pass after reusing GuildLeadership.Leader for invitation authority.
validation: Guildless and orphaned member invitations return without exceptions or consent mutation.
Wrong leader name, replaced guild, detached member and inconsistent rank are rejected.
A canonical ordinary leader reaches the blacklist rule and can offer an unblocked invitation.
Offering alone does not join the target or change guild membership.
limitations: Offline packet adapter; no database, native client, successful membership transaction or live service execution.
Existing saved admission and cold recovery evidence is not rerun or expanded by these tests.
Initial fixture compilation required qualifying ambiguous names; positive-case fixture required normal empty weapon state. These were harness corrections, not production defects.
GeoIP.dat absence is reported by static initialization in the artifact-only directory; all focused checks pass without it.
Private game build retains existing warnings; focused harness compiles with warnings as errors.
Installed career runtime and live server remain unchanged.
